statements.t: “As we advance EVO301 into Phase 2b and expand into ulcerative colitis, 2027 will be a year of execution and clinical catalysts for Evommune, with additional new clinical studies across EVO646 and EVO570 and Phase 2b migraine top-line data expected from EVO756.

dropped.t: That gap is where we believe EVO756 can make a difference, as it targets neurogenic mast cell biology and non-histaminergic itch.
We are very excited to have the Phase 2b trial now underway and expect top-line data next year,” said Luis Peña, President and Chief Executive Officer at Evommune.

Phase 2b Top-Line Data Readout in AD Expected Next Month: The Company expects to report top-line data in September 2026 for the fully-enrolled Phase 2b dose-ranging clinical trial (N=120) in moderate-to-severe AD patients.

Migraine Prophylaxis Phase 2b Trial Now Underway with Top-Line Data Anticipated in 2027: In July 2026 , the Company initiated a global randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2b dose-ranging clinical trial in migraine prophylaxis.

Full Results from Positive Phase 2a Trial in AD to be Presented at Upcoming Medical Conference: The full dataset from the positive Phase 2a trial in adult patients with moderate-to-severe AD will be presented at an upcoming medical conference, where the Company plans disclosure on key secondary endpoints as well as key biomarker data showing Th2 and non-Th2 biomarker impact supporting the breadth of IL-18…
